name: maa-saraswati
description: MAA SARASWATI - dairy products website (React frontend + Express API)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy client/dist --project-name maa-saraswati-diary --branch main
scripts.deploy:pages:check: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy client/dist --project-name maa-saraswati-diary --branch main --dry-run
